prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: provisional technical test still for image-to-video animation; not approved fictional canon
Primary request: Create one cozy, quiet small reading room at night with one adult person seated reading an open book, both hands resting naturally on the book, a ceramic tea cup on a small nearby table, a softly lit desk lamp, and a rain-streaked window.
Style/medium: clean painted illustration with subtle pixel-art-inspired crisp simplified shapes, restrained surface texture, readable silhouette, stable straight furniture geometry.
Composition/framing: portrait 4:5 aspect ratio. A fixed medium-wide camera includes the seated adult from head to shoes, the whole chair, nearby table, lamp, and rain-streaked window. Natural three-quarter view of the adult, visible calm face and both eyes, believable adult proportions, relaxed shoulders. Keep the face large enough to support a subtle blink animation and torso readable enough for gentle breathing.
Lighting/mood: soft warm lamp light inside, cool dark nighttime light at the window, calm and understated.
Constraints: exactly one adult, one open book, one cup, simple coherent room, hands anatomically plausible and resting still. This is a neutral animation test scene. No named world motifs. No text, lettering, signage, logos, watermark, panel borders, motion blur, or motion lines. Opaque background. No changes of camera or multiple frames.
notes: One adult seated reading; hands and both eyes visible.
Warm lamp, ceramic cup, rain-streaked window, coherent chair and table geometry.
Generated composition includes a sleeping cat, plants, bookshelf and wall art as background furnishings.
Technical test image only; no fictional names, lore or canon claims.
No image edits or resizing performed; use workflow resize for H3 test dimensions.
